Whoever intentionally lies about the Prophet or ascribes to him what he did not say will take his seat in the Fire, which made some companions narrate little.
Knowingly claiming a false father is disbelief and a false people earns the Fire; such claims, invented dreams and sayings falsely ascribed to the Prophet are among the worst lies.
A woman asked if she may claim her husband gave her what he had not, to tease his other wife; the Prophet likened this to wearing two garments of falsehood.
Whoever does not give up false statements, evil deeds and bad words, Allah has no need of his leaving food and drink in fasting.
In a dream the Prophet was shown a man whose cheek was being torn, a liar whose lies spread over the world, punished so until the Day of Resurrection.
The worst lie is claiming a false dream, its teller made to knot two barley grains; eavesdroppers get molten lead in their ears, and picture-makers must put souls in pictures.
